name: Boon of Fate
summary: An epic boon that adds or subtracts 2d4 from a nearby creature's D20 Test.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.text: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

benefits.name: Improve Fate
benefits.text: When you or another creature within 60 feet of you succeeds on or fails a {ref:glossary/d20-test}, you can roll 2d4 and apply the total rolled as a bonus or penalty to the d20 roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll {ref:glossary/initiative} or finish a Short or {ref:glossary/long-rest}.
